intents.name: crime_help
templates: 🕶️ *Crime* — .crime <id> to run a job. Bigger score = bigger heat. Check the list with .crime, watch your heat with .wanted, and stash profits in .bank.

intents.name: rob_help
templates: 🔫 *Rob* — .rob <@player|number> to snatch their on-hand cash. Success depends on your stealth vs their security. Guards can stop you. Cooldown applies.

intents.name: raid_help
templates: 💥 *Raid* — .raid <@player|number>. Heavier than a rob: bigger payout, bigger risk, bigger heat. Bring hearts you can afford to lose.

intents.name: hit_help
templates: 🎯 *Hit* — .hit <@player|number> to attack a player directly. Damage scales with strength vs defense. Check .battle for duels.

intents.name: biz_help
templates: 🏢 *Businesses* — .biz to browse, .biz buy <id> to purchase, .collect to pocket profits, .biz upgrade <id> to scale, .insure to protect them. Passive income is king.

intents.name: collect_help
templates: 💵 .collect pulls income from all your businesses. It builds up over time — collect often, upgrade often.

intents.name: bank_help
templates: 🏦 *Bank* — .deposit <amount> to stash cash (safe from robberies), .withdraw to pull it out, .bank to check balance. Banked cash can still be hit with .brob — keep guards.

intents.name: deposit_help
templates: 🏦 .deposit <amount> — moves cash into your bank where robbers can't touch it (mostly). Example: .deposit 50000

intents.name: withdraw_help
templates: 💸 .withdraw <amount> — pulls cash out of your bank. You need liquid cash to .pay, .buy and .biz upgrade.

intents.name: crypto_help
examples: what is crypto in this game
templates: 🪙 *Crypto* — .crypto to see the market, .crypto buy <SYM> <amt> to enter, .crypto sell <SYM> <amt> to exit, .crypto portfolio to check bags. Prices move on their own — volatility is the game.

intents.name: shop_help
templates: 🛒 .shop lists every item, .buy <id> to purchase, .inv to see your bag, .equip to gear up. Some items are role-locked.

intents.name: inventory_help
examples: how do i see my items
templates: 🎒 .inv shows everything you carry — gear, consumables, cards. Equip weapons and armor with .equip <id>.

intents.name: daily_help
templates: 🎁 .daily claims free cash every 24h. Miss a day and the streak resets — streaks pay bigger. Stack it with .dailies for contract jobs.

intents.name: leaderboard_help
templates: 🏆 .lb shows the richest players, .al shows achievement rankings. Climb by stacking net worth (cash + bank).

intents.name: profile_help
templates: 👤 .profile shows your cash, bank, level, stats, heat, wanted level and badges. Check it after every grind session.

intents.name: heist_help
templates: 💎 *Heists* — solo: .sh (safe) / .jh (jackpot) / .bh (big). Lobby: .heist safe|risky then .join heist. Prep with .safe prep / .risky prep for better odds. Big score, big heat.

intents.name: poker_help
templates: 🃏 *Poker* — .poker create <buyin> to open a table, .poker join <id>, .poker deal, then .poker hold|fold each round. Winner takes the pot.

intents.name: blackjack_help
templates: 🃏 *Blackjack* — .bj <bet> to start, then .bj hit / .bj stand / .bj double. Get close to 21 without busting. Dealer stands on 17.

intents.name: dice_help
templates: 🎲 .dice <bet> high|low — call the roll, double or nothing. The house edge is real.

intents.name: slots_help
templates: 🎰 .slots <bet> — spin the reels. Match 3 for the jackpot. House always wins long-term; quit while ahead.

intents.name: coinflip_help
templates: 🪙 .coinflip <bet> heads|tails — 50/50, pure nerve. Example: .coinflip 5000 heads

intents.name: spell_help
templates: 🔤 .spell <bet> — I show a scrambled word, you unscramble it. Answer with .spell answer <word>. Fast and correct = payout.

intents.name: riddle_help
templates: 🧩 .riddle starts one, .riddle <answer> to solve. Correct answers pay cash. Wrong ones pay pride.

intents.name: jail_help
examples: how do i get out of jail
phrases: how to get out of jail
templates: 🔐 *Jail* — check status with .jail, buy freedom with .bail, or gamble on .escape (fail = more time). Doing crime while wanted raises the risk.

intents.name: prison_help
examples: what can i do in prison
templates: 🔐 *Prison life* — .work earns small cash, .commissary lists supplies, .smuggle is risky money. Keep your head down or stretch your sentence.

intents.name: launder_help
templates: 🧼 .launder <amount> — converts dirty cash clean for a fee. Businessmen launder cheaper. Big washes can raise flags — split them up.

intents.name: guild_help
templates: 🛡️ *Guilds* — .guild create <name> to found one, .guild join <name> to join, .guild battle for wars, .territory to hold blocks. Stronger together.

intents.name: territory_help
templates: 🗺️ .territory claim <name> — plant your flag. Territory generates respect and income. Defend it or lose it.

intents.name: battle_help
templates: ⚔️ *Battle* — .battle <@player> to challenge, .battle accept to take it, then .strike / .heavy / .aim / .guard / .special each turn. HP hits 0 → hospital.

intents.name: pay_help
templates: 💸 .pay <@player|number> <amount> — straight cash transfer. No refunds, no takebacks.

intents.name: bounty_help
templates: 🎯 *Bounties* — .bounty <@player> <amount> to put a price on someone's head, .bounties to view the board, .claim <id> to collect a finished hit.

intents.name: contracts_help
templates: 📜 .contracts shows the board, .accept <id> takes a job, .complete <id> when it's done. Hitman contracts pay best.

intents.name: news_help
templates: 📰 .news pulls the latest city feed — events, heat waves, lockdowns and player drama.

intents.name: heat_help
templates: 🚨 *Heat & Wanted* — crime raises heat. High heat = more busts, hospital time and manhunts. It decays over time; .bank your cash and lay low. .wanted shows your status.

intents.name: guards_help
templates: 🛡️ *Guards* — .hire <@player> to put them on payroll (Businessman, max 3). They block robberies while online. .fire to cut them loose.

intents.name: achievements_help
templates: 🏅 .achievements lists every badge and how to earn it. .al shows the badge leaderboard. Some badges are secret — keep playing.

intents.name: cooldown_help
templates: ⏳ .cd shows every cooldown you're sitting on. Cooldowns tick down in real time — plan your grind loop.

intents.name: daily_help
templates: 🎁 .daily — free cash every 24h. Streaks pay more. Miss a day, lose the streak. .dailies shows contract jobs too.

intents.name: leaderboard_help
templates: 🏆 .lb — richest players, .lb achievements for badges, .al for the badge board. Net worth = cash + bank.

intents.name: profile_help
templates: 👤 .profile — cash, bank, level, class, stats, heat, hearts and badges in one view. .profile is your ID in the city.

intents.name: crypto_help
templates: 🪙 *Crypto* — .crypto (market), .crypto buy <SYM> <amt>, .crypto sell <SYM> <amt>, .crypto portfolio, .crypto top. Volatile — paper hands get cooked.

intents.name: guild_help
templates: 🛡️ *Guilds* — .guild create <name>, .guild join <name>, .guild battle for wars, .territory to hold ground. Guilds split wins and share glory.

intents.name: battle_help

intents.name: heat_help

intents.name: jail_help
examples: how to get out of jail
templates: 🔐 *Jail* — .jail to check status, .bail to buy out, .escape to gamble on freedom (fail = more time). While inside: .work, .commissary, .smuggle.

intents.name: daily_help
templates: 🎁 .daily — free cash every day. Streaks multiply the payout; miss a day and it resets. .dailies adds contract jobs on top.

intents.name: leaderboard_help
templates: 🏆 .lb — cash rankings, .al — badge rankings. Rank = cash + bank. Get on it by stacking, not by asking 😎

intents.name: shop_help
examples: what can i buy in shop
templates: 🛒 .shop — item catalog, .buy <id> to purchase, .inv to check your bag, .equip to gear up. Name Change Card lives here too.

intents.name: heist_types
examples: what is the difference between safe and risky heist
templates:
💎 *Heist tiers*
▸ .sh — safe heist: low risk, low heat
▸ .jh — jackpot heist: medium
▸ .bh — big heist: high risk, high heat
▸ .safe / .risky — multiplayer lobbies
Prep before you go in.

intents.name: pvp_help
templates: 🔫 *PvP* — .rob (steal cash), .raid (heavy hit), .hit (assault), .battle (turn-based duel), .brob (bank raid). Every move builds heat — and targets.

intents.name: cooldown_help
templates: ⏳ .cd shows every cooldown and its timer. Cooldowns keep the city fair — chain your loop: .crime → .collect → .daily.

intents.name: wanted_help
templates: 🚨 .wanted shows your wanted level. It decays over time — or cools faster if you stop committing crimes. High wanted = higher bust chance on every job.

intents.name: pay_help
examples: how to give money to someone
templates: 💸 .pay <@player|number> <amount> — instant transfer. No refunds, no chargebacks, no tears.

intents.name: bounty_help

intents.name: territory_help

intents.name: battle_help

intents.name: payday
templates: 💵 .collect builds up over time — check .biz for rates, .cd for timers. Stack businesses to stack the drip.

intents.name: synai_about
templates: 🧠 *SynAI* — the offline intelligence engine inside Syn Bot. Pattern matching + TF-IDF intent classification + a teachable knowledge base. No LLM, no API, no keys, no cost. <100ms answers, 24/7.
